notes.title: Team Ladybug's First Original Metroidvania: Blade Chimera Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Team Ladybug and Metroidvania fans,

Today, we are proud to have released Blade Chimera, Team Ladybug's very first original Metroidvania!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/71d994cf25003cca1775534cce0bf2d6ae9370d0.png

Building upon feedback we received from players of Touhou Luna Nights and Record of Lodoss War -Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth-, Blade Chimera has 3 fully original maps and a large variety of sidequests for you to complete. It's a longer, richer experience that any past Team Ladybug game, and it has a fresh demo on Steam for you to try out as well!

One of the game's defining features is the ability to warp anywhere on the map, which is pretty unusual for a Metroidvania. It allows quick, convenient travelling across the large maps without trivializing movement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/7cfcde4853a5bfc515d7cf33c7b2129f50374e2d.gif

Special Collaboration with the IGAvania Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night—the Metroidvania New Generation Bundle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/c27cc938de4682cfee6c3098ac097cb1bdabe9bd.png

Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night, one of the most iconic titles by IGA, the great founding father of the Metroidvania genre itself, is collaborating with us to create this bundle. The collaboration is scheduled to last until the end of February.

Actually, IGA, Shutaro, and Ladybug have actually talked in a "Metroidvania round table" before, where Ladybug reveals that he strives to emulate their work in his own. That was what paved the way for this collaboration.

Until today, the discussion was only transcribed in Japanese, but to commemorate this collaboration, we've gotten special permission from Famitsu to translate it into English and Simplified Chinese. The translations are available to read on the PLAYISM website, and there you can read about just how much Ladybug was influenced by Symphony of the Night.

Click here to read the article if you're interested!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36872249/7e4e9a61d823ddb60cbd0dfc48311383bd6eb73f.gif

We've also received comments from IGA and Ladybug concerning the Metroidvania New Generation bundle, which are exclusively featured in the following Famitsu article. The comments are only available in Japanese, but you can't read them anywhere else, so we'll share the link with you anyway!

Click here to read a message from Ladybug and IGA! (Japanese only; available from 6 PM JST)

And here's the link to the collaborative bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49181/

The Team Ladybug bundle is also on sale for Blade Chimera's launch, and we've also added Blade Chimera emotes to our official server. There's a lot going on as we celebrate the game's launch, so please check out the details in the Blade Chimera Steam news!

We hope you'll play and enjoy Blade Chimera, and that you'll continue to support Team Ladybug!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20245/Team_Ladybug_Bundle/

notes.title: Team Ladybug's Newest Metroidvania: Blade Chimera Joins Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear all,

Thank you for playing Touhou Luna Nights/Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth.
The developers of this game, Team Ladybug, are currently working on the upcoming cyberpunk metroidvania Blade Chimera!

[previewyoutube=W2D1wgJtC2A;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2671230/_/

Play as Shin, a Demon Hunter who has lost his memories and is now exploring the world together with his sword—the transformed Lumina demon Lux—recollecting memories about yourself, your missing wife, and skills you've forgotten.

Each time you recollect a lost skill, Lux changes form according to the will of her wielder, making Shin stronger and granting access to more areas of the world. 

■ Game Features
In Blade Chimera, the demon Lux transforms into your trusty weapon—the Lumina Sword, which you will have to use to interfere with the past, create new platforms, and shield yourself from danger to explore a desolate world.

Other than the Lumina Sword, you will also have access to other weapons such as swift daggers and long-range guns. Find the perfect weapons to suit your fighting style.

This game features a skill tree system. Upon leveling up, you will receive points that can be spent on unlocking skills that will aid you on your journey. 

Blade Chimera is participating in Steam Next Fest right now with a brand new demo. If you're a fan of this game, you'll definitely know how much fun Team Ladybug's games are!

Take the Lumina Sword for a spin (maybe literally) and experience the addictive gameplay yourself!
And of course, the full game is exponentially more fun than just the demo, so please wishlist the game to be notified first when it releases iin August 2024!

Here's a trailer showing footage from Stage 2 and beyond!

[previewyoutube=_xn17w8ERg0;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_xn17w8ERg0[/previewyoutube]

We can't wait to hear your feedback!

We've also opened a new channel on the official PLAYISM Discord for the Steam Next Fest!
Feel free to stop by and chat with fellow players!

notes.title: Team Ladybug brings you the legendary Japanese fantasy classic Record of Lodoss War - as a 2D action game! Coming to Steam Early Access on March 13th - Record of Lodoss War: Deedlit in Wonder Labyrinth!
notes.content:
Attention Japanese Fantasy Fans 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/209e0d482d0e0fc328059cab429aef80e1d180ac.png

Touhou Luna Nights developer Team Ladybug is proud to bring you the globally revered classic of Japanese fantasy said to have single-handedly launched the "elf-shaped ears" trope, Record of Lodoss War in 2D action game form!

Featuring "Deedlit" - beloved heroine and symbol of Record of Lodoss War - this latest installment fills in the gaps from the most recent novel in the series released in August 2019.

"Deedlit awakens in a strange, unknown place. As she explores her surroundings, she encounters ""Ghim"" and more of her old friends. Where is this place? Receiving help from spirits including ""Sylph"" and ""Salamander"", Deedlit wanders this mysterious new world in search of answers...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/e17194da7c71b250d50988a92ec38c7b2e6d098d.gif

The Wonderous Spirit of the Novel Captured in 2D Action Form!

The game features both the beautiful 2D pixel artwork for which Team Ladybug is known as well as a unique Record of Lodoss War-based game system.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/6daae6f48730d019c8eb258d75543e5f9cad124a.gif

Harness the Power of the Spirits to Battle Through Each Stage

You'll need to take advantage of the powers possessed by the various spirits assisting Deedlit in her quest in order to make it through each stage.
When using Sylph, Deedlit becomes less vulnerable against wind and gains the ability to hover, allowing her to access certain areas. You must learn to use these powers wisely.

Master Myriad Types of Weaponry

Pick up and brandish the various weapons dropped by enemies, such as swords, knives, spears, and more. Learn to use each weapon according to its strengths: powerful swords are best for close-range melee attacks, while arrows can be used for ranged assaults, etc.
Of course, you can also sell these weapons off as well. Apart from attacking, there are also certain gimmicks which you'll need arrows to overcome. Part of the fun lies in cycling through the different weapons to find the one best suited for the situation.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/30c9287326947e6171a99151d42ad4aa3b840240.gif

Coming to Steam Early Access on March 13th!
As with Touhou Luna Nights, in order to provide the best and most finely-tuned final product possible via user feedback and requests, we will be releasing the Early Access version of the game on March 13th.
We look forward to receiving your feedback and opinions!

notes.title: Touhou Luna Nights out now in Early Access!
notes.content:
Touhou Luna Nights is a 2D metroidvania style game, developed by Team Ladybug, known for their titles KonoSuba: God's Blessing on this Wonderful World! Revival of Beldia (youtube) and Shin Megami Tensei: Synchronicity Prologue (youtube). Absolutely enchanted by the free-flowing, beautiful 2D worlds of the Touhou Project series, Team Ladybug took on the task of developing this title.

Team Ladybug began with Pharaoh Rebirth, continuing with other enjoyable games including Resurrection of Beldia and Shin Megami Tensei: Synchronicity Prologue. Since then, the world has been waiting in anticipation for their next project. 

This time, they have created a fan game based off the world-renowned Touhou Project. 
From the background to the character's movements and various skills, one can feel the creator's passion for games and love of the Touhou project.

While it is a 2D search game similar to Castlevania, players can easily progress through the game without the insistence of repetitive elements or collecting items. This has resulted in a spectacular game born from the game production skills cultivated by Team Ladybug.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/6e3ac50b773af34d4b4f196ac17679e64fc9669c.gif

On element we really want to highlight is the beauty of the anime-style sprites. 
You can see the attention to detail the creator put into not only the leading character's movements,
but also, the effects and enemy characters. 

Touhou Luna Nights is not only for Touhou fans but is also a game that anyone who enjoys 2D action games can dive right into.


Story
“Now... my world will begin...”

The vampire from the Scarlet Devil Mansion ,"Remilia Scarlet," suddenly sends her maid, "Sakuya Izayoi" to a parallel universe similar to Gensokyo.

A strange world, with strange youkai.
What is Remilia up to……?

Using her power to control time, Sakuya races through this parallel universe to find the truth behind this elaborate “game”, and to “perfectly” play along with Lady Remilia’s time-killing hobby...


https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/
